This app description contains blatantly false advertising. Podcasts are absolutely not ad-free with premium, and the ads are not "baked in" to the recording as they like to claim via their support services. Spotify shoves ads in via SIA (Streaming Ad Insertion, the term from their own website) which literally cuts away from the content to display an ad banner and play a separate audio track. And the ads are different on playback of subsequent episodes. This is very deceptive.
